{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent mean reversion toward lower levels after high peaks.",
    "Apply a mild downward bias when sentiment is negative (e.g., sentiment < 0.0), as models tend to overreact.",
    "Increase downward correction magnitude if true outcomes lag behind forecasts by more than 2-3 days in a row.",
    "Avoid overconfidence in short-term momentum; if history shows 3+ consecutive overestimations, reduce forecast amplitude.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending down, apply a slight downward adjustment to prevent overcorrection.",
    "If true outcomes consistently underperform forecasts in the last 5-7 days, consider a 5-10% downward bias for next period."
  ]
}
